answer.explanation: The live configuration of CompressionFunction has Timeout=3 s and MemorySize=128 MB, last modified at 21:11:30Z, two seconds before the window. The committed SAM template specifies Timeout 60 and MemorySize 1024, so this is configuration drift from the intended state. Within the window, nearly every invocation logs 'Duration: 3000.00 ms ... Status: timeout', with max memory used around 94-97 MB, so the function is being cut off by the 3 s timeout rather than running out of memory. IAM is not implicated, since the failures are timeouts rather than AccessDenied errors, and the other functions show no drift.
